correctness.rationale: The displayed simplicial faces are exactly graph edge sets covered by a pair. Independently compiled and executed the actual 2,103-character frozen verify_acyclic.cpp matching algorithm for m=8,9,10: respectively 202140, 1099623, 5673835 faces; 1372896, 8460504, 48937095 covering incidences; all acyclic. Critical cell vectors were (1,35,70), (1,70,126), (1,126,210) in dimensions 0,3,4. Independently ran the exact frozen signed-integral Morse reduction algorithm on all three orders: 70,126,210 critical-four-cell columns, all zero over Z. Since the three-skeleton is a wedge of S3, Hurewicz π3≅H3 makes every zero-degree S3 attaching map of the 4-cells nullhomotopic. This proves the three integral homotopy types, NOT the all-m conjecture. The C++ and Python algorithms were inspected and rerun, not inferred from log files.
